purpose: Section 24: real review-event volume/dedup/reason-distribution measurement against real, zero-cost, already-preserved FWRG and LSB coverage-audit evidence.
interpretation: Across 827 real semantic units (477 at CRITICAL/MATERIAL tier) from two real, independently-audited packages, 477 distinct claim-level review items were created - one per genuinely distinct, still-unresolved material claim, not one per raw pipeline event (the 477 total recordClaimReview() calls collapsed via dedup into 477 items - see CREATED vs OBSERVATION_APPENDED counts in claimReviewOutcomes for the exact aggregation ratio).
